trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. No multiplayer and no DLC is needed — every trophy is single-player. PowerPyx puts the whole run at about 200 hours at difficulty 4 out of 10, with the 100% completion checklist taking most of it. Use the roadmap tab to plan the run in three stages.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy — it unlocks when you finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. It cannot be missed. On Exophase's early tracking this is the most-earned trophy in the game: every tracked player has it.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Automatic — complete Chapter 1. PowerPyx notes chapter trophies pop a little late, usually after the first mission or two of the next chapter, so do not worry if it does not pop the instant the chapter ends. It cannot be missed.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Automatic — complete Chapter 2. It cannot be missed. The name is shown with asterisks exactly as PlayStation publishes it.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Automatic — complete Chapter 3. It cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Automatic — complete Chapter 4. It cannot be missed.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Automatic — complete the final mission. This is the only gold story trophy, and the only hidden gold in the list. It cannot be missed. After the ending, free roam continues and everything needed for the 100% checklist stays accessible.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Automatic — complete the main mission Breakfast Run. It cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Automatic — complete the main mission The Cartel Heist. It cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Automatic — complete the main mission Child's Play. It cannot be missed.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Automatic — complete the main mission Headliners. It cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Automatic — complete the main mission VCIA Takedown. It cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Automatic — complete the main mission Operation Savage Glory. It cannot be missed.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist, which appears after the story under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion. PowerPyx calls this the hardest trophy: the checklist is lenient — closer to 60% true completion — but it still takes about 100 hours. You need 70 of the 80 challenges, 15 of the 18 meditation spots and 300 stunts, but every robbery, underwater discovery, shooting range, drone race and Bret quest. Progress made during the story already counts.

sources.label: Six Shore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 stunts. Stunt jumps, flights under bridges, Knife Flights and base jumps all count, and you can mix them — PowerPyx counts 397 stunts in the game. The 100% checklist needs 300, so keep going past this one; fold stunts into your travel instead of grinding them all at once.

sources.label: Six Shore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each activity type once. PowerPyx lists nine: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt. You only need to try each one — no wins or scores required — so tick them off early while you are learning the map.

sources.label: Six Shore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge — 42 in all, per PowerPyx and PSNProfiles. Gold is about accuracy and speed together, not just hitting targets: learn each range's target pattern, keep your aim steady instead of snapping, and retry the awkward ones once you know the layout.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location — 14 in all. Drone races are short; learn each course's corners and cut them tight rather than flying flat out, and use the whole course width on the fast straights.

sources.label: Six Shore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any race type counts, so pick the ones that suit your driving and spread your wins across different events — winning the same race twice does not count twice.

sources.label: Six Shore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal texts you a fishing spot after you meet him in Chapter 1 — take the challenge when it comes and mind the line tension instead of reeling flat out. On Exophase's early tracking this is one of the most-earned side trophies, at 13.3% of tracked players.

sources.label: Six Shore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game — play one in-game video game through to the end. Three run on the TV at home and a fourth sits on arcade machines out in the world. Pick the shortest one and finish it in one sitting.

sources.label: Six Shore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's side strand. It starts with a phone call in Chapter 3 and is Lucia-only, so play it as Lucia. Follow Andy's calls and markers through the strand until the final mission is done.

sources.label: Six Shore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's treasure-diving strand — 7 shipwrecks in total. Kenton goes quiet after Chapter 1 and comes back later, so a gap is normal and the strand is not missable. Dive each wreck and the final mission closes the strand.

sources.label: Six Shore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's strand at the mud club in Kelly County. It opens in Chapter 2 — look for Billy's markers there and run the strand through to its final mission.

sources.label: Six Shore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. PowerPyx counts 14 strands in the game, but only some count toward this one and the exact set is still being confirmed — do them all and you will cover it. They stay available after the story, and Strangers & Freaks is not part of 100% completion, so it often ends up last on the list.

sources.label: Six Shore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's strand — a wish list of 16 sports cars. It opens in Chapter 3. Steal or buy the cars on the list and deliver them; check Randy's list often so you know which models still count.

sources.label: Six Shore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's strand by shutting down labs in Vice City. Jason-only, from Chapter 3. Work through the lab locations Tyrone marks until the strand's final mission.

sources.label: Six Shore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 in all. POSSIBLY MISSABLE: during Chapter 1, one morning at Jason's house after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia says she is going to meditate and walks out to the balcony — follow her and accept the optional quest. PowerPyx flags it because it is not clear whether that one counts toward the 18, and it is gone after Chapter 1. Do it when it comes up; it takes a minute. The 100% checklist needs 15 of the 18 spots. See the Missables tab for the full warning.

sources.label: Six Shore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Jason-only, from Chapter 2. PowerPyx has not confirmed which animal triggers it — clearing all 15 of Bret's target decks, which 100% completion needs anyway, should cover it. Hunt the decks as you go rather than saving them for the end.

sources.label: Six Shore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets out of 18 in the game. Cards are scattered across Leonida; track sets as you find them and finish any three. The 100% checklist needs 15 of the 18 sets, so this one pops early on the way there.

sources.label: Six Shore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Open the WAiNK phone app and scan landmarks, curiosities and sculptures — anything the app recognises counts. Scan as you travel and the total climbs on its own; the 100% checklist needs 100 WAiNK locations too, so this one and the checklist line finish together.

sources.label: Six Shore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. The game has 80 challenges in eight groups of ten, per PowerPyx. The 100% checklist needs 70, so this one pops on the way — pick the easy groups first and skip the hardest ones until the end.

sources.label: Six Shore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Possible once both characters can roam together, from Chapter 2. Bank jobs hand you 4 stars anyway, so this often pops during one — otherwise raise the heat with your partner along, then break line of sight and stay hidden until it drops.

sources.label: Six Shore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Hit three shops in a row with your partner along and keep the heat on — PowerPyx says it pops about 30 seconds after the third shop. Plan a route of three close shops first so you are not driving across the map between robberies.

sources.label: Six Shore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app is enough — you do not have to drive it. Scan everything new you pass and the count climbs fast; the 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning after this one pops.

sources.label: Six Shore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Before the fight, buff your focus with food, drinks or a shower at home, bring Adrenaline and use an assault rifle. PowerPyx notes gang members count, while soldiers, police and civilians seem not to — pick a gang fight for it, and trigger Combat Focus only once five targets are in front of you.

sources.label: Six Shore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Steal a passenger jet docked at a gate at Vice City International Airport and fly about 1 km away. Get in, get airborne and do not stop for the runway — distance is what counts.

sources.label: Six Shore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Steal a military tank — PowerPyx found them at Mile Zero Air Station in the southwest. Expect heavy resistance getting out; have an escape route planned before you climb in, and do not stop to fight on foot.

sources.label: Six Shore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. You need the Snap Gun, which a Chapter 3 main mission gives you — do not try this before then. Move quietly, take what you need and leave before anyone spots you; being seen at all fails it.

sources.label: Six Shore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Bank jobs open through an optional mission in Chapter 4; there are 8 vaults in all and the 100% checklist needs all of them. Plan the getaway before the job, not during it — a fast car parked close beats a perfect plan with no exit.

sources.label: Six Shore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. The first bank job counts, or you can blow open a truck's back door with a sticky bomb earlier. Grab the cash and break away fast — the truck itself is slow, the response is not.

sources.label: Six Shore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Clear the fog from the entire map — a plane is fastest. Sweep the state in grid lines and check the map for any fog left in the corners, especially the small islands and the far southwest.

sources.label: Six Shore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — 9 gangs in all. The 100% checklist needs all 39 operations, so this pops on the way there. Hit one operation per gang and keep a note of which gangs are done.

sources.label: Six Shore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The exact method is not yet confirmed by any guide — PowerPyx lists this one as unsolved. Try the Ocean Beach bars at sunset with a view over the water; this guide will be updated when the trigger is pinned down.

sources.label: Six Shore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The exact method is not yet confirmed — PowerPyx lists it as unsolved. A showroom, a fast car and a straight line through the glass is the obvious read; this guide will be updated when the trigger is pinned down.

sources.label: Six Shore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Take all 3 key valuables from the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn. The robbery comes back later if you miss something, so it is not missable.

sources.label: Six Shore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. Max out strength on both Jason and Lucia — work out together and both make progress. Note: Push Square does not mark this one hidden, so your console may show it from the start.

sources.label: Six Shore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). Do 500 things that change your criminal profile. It comes naturally across a full playthrough — robberies, crimes and choices all feed the profile, so do not grind it; let it pop while you play.

sources.label: Six Shore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Not yet confirmed — PowerPyx suspects a link to a Payday Loans store. This guide will be updated when the trigger is pinned down.

sources.label: Six Shore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Not yet confirmed — PowerPyx suspects a UFO questline. Keep an eye on strange lights and odd encounters out in the countryside; this guide will be updated when the trigger is pinned down.

sources.label: Six Shore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Not yet confirmed — the in-game hint points to a melee attack from a moving vehicle, and PowerPyx suspects a kick from a motorcycle. Try a melee swing from a moving bike at a pedestrian and see if it pops.

sources.label: Six Shore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills pile up from robberies; launder them through fences and the total adds up across jobs. The dye pack jammer unlocks in a Chapter 3 main mission and makes the bigger hauls safer.

sources.label: Six Shore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos get you there fastest — buy the expensive gear you would want anyway and the total climbs without wasting money.

sources.label: Six Shore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — 8 in all. PowerPyx puts the total at about $160,000, and the real estate app arrives in Chapter 2. Buy them as the money comes in; you will need the garage space for the Scooter Bros registrations too.

sources.label: Six Shore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. You need garage space first, so pair it with Little Boxes — store a vehicle, open the app and register it. Any ten vehicles count.

sources.label: Six Shore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List
